summary: Thirteen days to FreightWorks Expo. Reno has run clean since the cleanup, and the root-cause fix (PR #238) awaits Arjun's review. Harbor QBR is at 2pm today, with the renewal terms one-pager (TW-136) still open. Coastal is live in staging and Valley has data access. Pinecrest demo is Monday.

items.text: Reno double-bookings cleaned up (TW-133 done). Maya called Omar (TW-134 done) and told him the fix is in and root cause is next. Omar says Reno ran clean this morning.
Duplicate-appointments root-cause fix for TW-103 is up as PR #238. It cannot ship until Arjun reviews it (TW-137, todo).

Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had duplicates three times this quarter and copied its CFO. Duplicates are quiet now but the root cause is not yet shipped. TW-113 renewal prep is todo.
Arjun says the retry queue (TW-104) goes to production tomorrow, Friday.
Nina's sync error-rate alert (TW-105) is in progress. Arjun cites it as the answer to how Harbor would learn of an outage. Nina is on call this week, Arjun from Oct 26.
Harbor QBR is at 2pm today. Deck (TW-112) covers Q3 usage, the export fix and the time zone display. Harbor is 38% of revenue and renews Oct 30. Jordan's final deck numbers were due this morning.
Dana wants the Harbor renewal terms on one page before the 2pm QBR. TW-136 is owned by Maya, due today, still todo.
Arjun will speak to the Sep 28 outage if Dana asks; the postmortem is done. Harbor may also raise the weekly usage report, which they liked.
Ranking is wired into the scoring API (TW-115, due Oct 28); load testing is next. Arjun also added TW-138 for Nina: suggestions look off for Coastal's early-morning docks, due Oct 28.
Design partners need API endpoint docs (TW-127, Arjun, due Oct 26), now in progress. Coastal is live in staging; Valley has data access and can start Smart Slots setup next week.
Slot picker design is frozen. Leila says the picker must be stable by Oct 28 for the booth tablet. TW-117 is due Oct 29. TW-135 (empty and error states) is in progress.
Expo demo screen 3 (TW-119, due Oct 30) waits for the slot picker build. Screens 1 and 2 are done.
Sam's pricing page draft (TW-125) is in Figma but waits on final pricing numbers. Maya promised them by Friday for the printed one-pager.
Pinecrest live demo is booked for Monday (Oct 26). Pinecrest is still unsigned as third design partner (TW-126, due Oct 30). Signing would meet the launch goal.
Maya's investor update (TW-111, due Oct 23) has a draft done but needs October numbers.
Expo invites to 40 target accounts (TW-122, due Oct 28) are in progress with Jordan. Booth 412 is confirmed.
Arjun finished the first backend candidate interview; the second is tomorrow (TW-110).
